scope: Docs/data/tools only. No src/e2e/CSS change, no runtime recipe added, no production set decided.

classDefinitions.A: current mechanics only (existing ingredients + existing sauce profile; NO_CUT allowed)
classDefinitions.B: small data/profile addition (new ingredient rows, new PAINT sauce profile)
classDefinitions.C: Cooking Steps extension on existing seams (FINISH post-bake, MULTI_SPREAD_LAYER, STEP_ORDER, sauce-less scoring)
classDefinitions.D: new mechanic (DOUGH_VARIANT, PAN_BAKE, DOUGH_SHAPE_TARGET, ENCLOSE, PREP_STEP, ZONED_PLACEMENT, LAMINATE, FRY_COOK, mid-bake)
classDefinitions.E: evidence insufficient or Owner decision first (E_EVIDENCE / E_OWNER_DECISION / E_RUNTIME_SET_COLLISION)
classDefinitions.RUNTIME: already one of the 25 runtime recipes

waveOptions.thesis: Ship immediately on the W1 pipeline: 9 recipes, 8 new ingredients, first white (fromage-blanc) base, first seafood-in-oil and pesto-protein variants, two no-CUT pizzas. Adds count and flavour, few new ways to play.
